Name: SlimBosco's Alex Portrait Mod
Author: farmerbosco
Description:
[size=3][b]REQUIREMENTS
[/b][/size]- [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]﻿
- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url]﻿

[size=3][b]INSTALLATION
[/b][/size]- put the .png image in the folder: Stardew Valley\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits\SlimBosco
- since this is only Alex you can mix and match with other portrait mods by swapping it out with the Alex portrait in another folder or just keep it alone in a newly  created 'SlimBosco' folder. [i]*either way it must be in another folder in the portraits folder to work*[/i]
- press 'p' in game during dialogue to flip through the portraits

[b][size=3]DESCRIPTION
[/size][/b]I think Alex is a character that people seem to picture pretty differently from person to person, and since he's my favorite I wanted to have a portrait that represented how I picture him better. Right now I have no plans to make any other portraits. 

You can edit or redistribute or do whatever as long as you [i]link back here and credit me.
[/i]No claiming as your own or making a profit from it.
